name: Diana Venicia
source:
In a world of stages and bright lights, the Ultimate Cosmetologist is here to make everyone beautiful. Before working as a personal stylist for some of the biggest names in the media, Diana was just a simple girl trying to make it thought high school. Being friends with the most popular group has its advantages, and gave this happy-go-lucky artist the opportunity she needed to show off her talents, and pursue her goal of helping everyone discover the best version of themselves.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1354222346253586436]official description[/url]]
